mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 55 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park and a Waxing Gibbous moon overhead.

The city has announced that chip seal road treatment begins September 23. Roadways will remain open, but expect lane closures on Cross Country Road, East Verona Avenue, and within the Liberty Business Park. Also, the Plan Commission will review several development proposals on October 5.

There is plenty to do in our city. Yoga at Insight Wellness is today, while Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia, and Dream Day Trivia are all happening tomorrow. Plus, look forward to the Verona Fall Fest this September 25 at Hometown USA Festival Park.
Regarding local public safety, on September 5, officers investigated a series of reports involving cheese slices left on vehicle windshields, which was linked to a viral social media prank.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a facility remodel, but we look forward to welcoming you when we open today at 10:00 AM.
